# Dynamic Dimension Type Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement `IxDyn` with its constructors, `Dimension` implementation, and `DimensionExt` implementation so Xenon can represent runtime-rank shapes with checked overflow handling.

**Architecture:** `IxDyn` owns a `Vec<usize>` shape buffer and is the only dynamic-rank `Dimension` implementation. The type performs checked element-count multiplication and exposes ergonomic constructors without imposing any artificial rank cap.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/02-dimension.md` §5.3 (IxDyn), `design/02-dimension.md` §6.1 (conversion rules), `design/02-dimension.md` §10 (semantic boundaries), `design/26-error.md` §4.2 (InvalidShape / DimensionMismatch)

**Prerequisites:** W3T1 must be complete.

### Task 2: Implement `IxDyn`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/dimension/dynamic.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete `dynamic.rs` implementation**

Replace `src/dimension/dynamic.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::private::Sealed;

use super::{Dimension, DimensionExt};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct IxDyn {
    pub(crate) dims: Vec<usize>,
}

impl IxDyn {
    #[inline]
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { dims: Vec::new() }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Self {
        Self {
            dims: slice.to_vec(),
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn from_vec(dims: Vec<usize>) -> Self {
        Self { dims }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn from_element(value: usize, ndim: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            dims: vec![value; ndim],
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn ones(ndim: usize) -> Self {
        Self::from_element(1, ndim)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn zeros(ndim: usize) -> Self {
        Self::from_element(0, ndim)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn into_vec(self) -> Vec<usize> {
        self.dims
    }
}

impl Sealed for IxDyn {}

impl Dimension for IxDyn {
    const NDIM: Option<usize> = None;

    fn ndim(&self) -> usize {
        self.dims.len()
    }

    fn slice(&self) -> &[usize] {
        &self.dims
    }

    fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
        let mut acc = 1usize;
        for (axis, &dim) in self.dims.iter().enumerate() {
            let previous = acc;
            acc = acc.checked_mul(dim).ok_or(XenonError::InvalidShape {
                operation: "Dimension::checked_size".into(),
                shape: self.dims.clone(),
                expected_elements: previous,
                actual_elements: dim,
                offending_dim: Some(axis),
                reason: Some("element count overflow".into()),
            })?;
        }
        Ok(acc)
    }

    fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError> {
        self.checked_size().map(|_| ())
    }

    fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn {
        self
    }

    fn try_from_dyn(dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        Ok(dyn_dim)
    }

    fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        Ok(Self::from_slice(slice))
    }
}

impl DimensionExt for IxDyn {
    fn slice_mut(&mut self) -> &mut [usize] {
        &mut self.dims
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::IxDyn;
    use crate::dimension::Dimension;
    use crate::error::XenonError;

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_from_slice() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_slice(&[2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[2, 3, 4]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_from_vec() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_vec(vec![1, 2, 3]);
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[1, 2, 3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_from_element() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_element(5, 3);
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[5, 5, 5]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_ones() {
        let dim = IxDyn::ones(4);
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[1, 1, 1, 1]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_zeros() {
        let dim = IxDyn::zeros(3);
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[0, 0, 0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_size() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_vec(vec![2, 3, 4]);
        assert_eq!(dim.checked_size().unwrap(), 24);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_checked_size_overflow_reports_offending_dim() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_vec(vec![usize::MAX, 2]);
        let err = dim.checked_size().unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            XenonError::InvalidShape {
                operation,
                shape,
                expected_elements: usize::MAX,
                actual_elements: 2,
                offending_dim: Some(1),
                reason: Some(reason),
            } if operation == "Dimension::checked_size" && shape == vec![usize::MAX, 2] && reason == "element count overflow"
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_into_vec() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_vec(vec![7, 8]);
        assert_eq!(dim.into_vec(), vec![7, 8]);
    }
}
```
